review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision case. The original PRD explicitly leaves material DEC-001 unresolved: AC-001 and AC-002 describe conditional acceptance under the recommended option, not authorization to select it. Gold correctly requires blocked readiness, the requirement-decision-pending reason keyed to DEC-001, and evidence through repository, requirements, and decisions, without assignable task expectations. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, repository identity/base commit, and paired-case identity agree with the specification. The complete supplied source supports index.js and index.d.ts as the implementation and public-contract inspection owners; limitFunction forwards clearQueue and its declaration uses Pick, so these consumers do not introduce additional mandatory edits. No declaration-generation evidence displaces index.d.ts as an owner. test.js and index.test-d.ts are the appropriate runtime and type-verification scopes, and package.json confirms the separate xo, ava, and tsd checks. Empty team membership and capability claims do not justify assignments and are consistent with stopping before task allocation. All release-input fingerprint fields and budgets in Gold match the frozen preview, including repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, and policy identifiers. The source-manifest digest is a separately labeled fingerprint, not asserted to be the release-input source digest. The original specification's preparatory null releaseInput and remaining-work list are distinguished from the supplied frozen preview. This review neither supplies a human Decision nor treats any paired hypothetical case as one. Digest binding is accepted as Service-provided; no digests were independently recomputed, no code was executed, and no candidate results were used.
